Hi Sam — thanks for the note and the screenshot. Sorry for the friction here.

Quick checklist so we can proceed:
1) Please confirm the target org id you want the credits moved to (you listed org-PLG-12345 — is that correct?).
2) Confirm whether Brightleaf Labs (org-sandbox-54321) and Brightleaf Analytics (org-PLG-12345) are under the same company billing contact. If so the transfer is straightforward.
3) If you prefer self-serve, you can follow this doc: https://docs.redwood.com/self-serve/credit-transfer — it allows moving promotional credits between workspaces that share the same billing owner. If you run into the UI path we can do a manual move.

If you reply with the org ids I'll start an internal request to move the credits immediately (we can escalate to manual transfer if the self-serve flow doesn’t apply).
